resources.string: Tesɛiḍ amiḍan XMPP ? Yezmer ad yili waya ma yella tesseqdaceḍ yakan amsaɣ niḍen n XMPP neɣ tesqedceḍ Conversations yakan. Ma yella ulac, snulfu-d amiḍan amaynut XMPP tura.\nTamawt: Kra n yisaǧǧawen n yimayl ttmuddun imiḍanen XMPP.

XMPP d asaǧǧaw ilelli n uzeṭṭa n unermes amiran. Tzemreḍ ad tesqedceḍ asnas-a akked yal aqeddac n XMPP ara tferneḍ.\nD acu, i wakken ad tifsus fell-ak, nerra asnulfu n umiḍan deg conversation.im; d asaǧǧaw i yeddan akked useqdec n Conversations.
Tettusnubegteḍ ɣer %1$s. Ad nili yid-k ɣef teɣzi n usnulfu n umiḍan.\nMi ara tferneḍ n %1$s d asaǧǧaw, ad tizmireḍ akked yiseqdacen s tikci n tansa-k XMPP tummidt.
Tettusnubegteḍ ɣer %1$s. Yettwafrren-ak yakan yisem n useqdac. Ad nili yid-k ɣef teɣzi n usnulfu n umiḍan.\nAd tizmireḍ akked yiseqdacen s tikci n tansa-k XMPP tummidt.
Ur tettwamsal ara tengalt akken iwata
Sit ɣef tqeffalt n beṭṭu i tuzna n tinnubga i unermas-ik ɣer %1$s.
Ma yella anermas-ik yeqreb, yezmer ad ifreḍ tangalt ddaw i uqbal n tinnubga.
